tokens.name: bg-primary
tokens.usage: Page background behind every section. The site is dark only; never put a page on white.

tokens.name: bg-secondary
tokens.usage: Default Card fill, StatusBadge fill, secondary Button, scrollbar track.

tokens.name: bg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the secondary Button; alternate section bands.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: elevated Card, primary Button, Input fields.

tokens.name: bg-muted
tokens.usage: Quiet wells inside a section, one step off bg-primary.

tokens.name: brand-red
tokens.usage: The accent. Accent Button fill, links, focus ring, the red word in a headline, code text. 4.11:1 on bg-primary: fine for 24px+ text, icons and borders, but below AA for small body text (prose links use it today; flagged).

tokens.name: brand-red-light
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the accent Button. White text on it is 4.0:1, under AA for 16px text (flagged).

tokens.name: brand-red-dark
tokens.usage: Pressed or deeper red. White text on it is 5.89:1.

tokens.name: brand-red-glow
tokens.usage: Soft red halo behind hero elements and selected items.

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Pure black: the app icon tile and logo grounds.

tokens.name: logo-red
tokens.usage: Red of the logo files (the triangle in the A and the brackets around SOFT). Use only inside the logo; UI red is brand-red.

tokens.name: logo-white
tokens.usage: Off-white ink of the logo on dark grounds. Use only inside the logo; UI text is text-primary.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on bg-primary (19.8:1), bg-elevated, and on brand-red fills (4.82:1).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy and article prose on bg-primary (15.7:1) and bg-secondary.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles, kickers, captions, placeholders. 5.73:1 on bg-primary, 4.77:1 on bg-elevated: don't go lighter than bg-elevated behind it.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (2.23:1 on bg-primary, exempt as inactive). Never for readable text.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline around default Cards and between list rows. Decorative only: not enough contrast to mark a control alone.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Borders of elevated Cards, Inputs and the primary and outline Buttons.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover border of Inputs; scrollbar thumb hover.

tokens.name: border-red
tokens.usage: Faint red edge on the default StatusBadge and highlighted cards.

tokens.name: border-red-glow
tokens.usage: Stronger red edge for a hovered or active highlighted card.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Overlay on ghost and outline controls under the pointer.

tokens.name: state-active
tokens.usage: Overlay while a control is pressed or a menu item is current.

tokens.name: state-focus
tokens.usage: Soft focus halo around Inputs (paired with a brand-red border).

tokens.name: cta-red-900
tokens.usage: Start of the CTA banner gradient (135deg, 0%), and the text colour of the white button on it (10:1).

tokens.name: cta-red-800
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the CTA banner gradient (40%).

tokens.name: cta-red-700
tokens.usage: End of the CTA banner gradient (100%). White text on it is 6.47:1.

tokens.name: pill-red-fill
tokens.usage: Fill and border of tag Pills on case studies, under brand-red text. That pair is 3.16:1 at 12px (flagged).

tokens.name: code-red-fill
tokens.usage: Background of inline code in articles, under brand-red text.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success dot and text in StatusBadge (10:1 on bg-secondary).

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning dot and text in StatusBadge (10.2:1 on bg-secondary).

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Info dot and text in StatusBadge. 3.88:1 on bg-secondary: OK for the dot, under AA for its small text (flagged).

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Input error label and message (5.81:1 on bg-primary, 4.84:1 on bg-elevated).

styles.name: hero-display
styles.usage: The one H1 on the home page at 1280px+ (36/48/60px at smaller widths). Balanced wrapping. One word may be brand-red.

styles.name: hero-kicker
styles.usage: Muted first half of a two-tier H1, in text-muted. Same H1 element, so SEO reads one heading.

styles.name: section-header
styles.usage: Wide-tracked medium-weight title of the contact block at 1280px+ (22px mobile, 32px from 1024px).

styles.name: prose-h2
styles.sample: What Our Application Security Audit Covers
styles.usage: H2 in blog posts, case studies and service pages, text-primary.

styles.name: prose-h3
styles.usage: H3 under an H2, after a connecting paragraph.

styles.name: prose-h4
styles.usage: Rare fourth level in long articles.

styles.name: prose-body
styles.sample: We review the code your team ships and rank every finding by risk.
styles.usage: Article paragraphs and list items in text-secondary, max 65ch wide.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Krasty Soft is a B2B software development company.
styles.usage: Hero subtitle and intro paragraph in text-muted (16px mobile, 18px tablet).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Interface copy, Input text, card text.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Label of the md Button (sm 14px, lg 18px, xl 20px).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Input labels, footer links, meta lines.

styles.name: table-label
styles.usage: Uppercase column heads in Problem / Solution tables.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a section header, in text-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks in blog posts (text-primary on a 10% grey well); inline code is brand-red on code-red-fill.

spacing.note: Components use Tailwind's 4px scale (tw-*); the spacing-c-* values are the site's custom section rhythm.

tokens.name: tw-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a Button's icon and label (sm, md); py of the sm Button.

tokens.name: tw-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside lg/xl Buttons and StatusBadge; py of the md Button and Input.

tokens.name: tw-4
tokens.usage: Card padding sm; px of the sm Button and md Input; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: tw-6
tokens.usage: Card padding md (default); px of the md Button and StatusBadge.

tokens.name: tw-8
tokens.usage: Card padding lg; px of the lg Button; CTA banner side padding.

tokens.name: tw-10
tokens.usage: Card padding xl; px of the xl Button; space under the hero subtitle.

tokens.name: spacing-c-22
tokens.usage: Custom 22px step used in tight section stacks.

tokens.name: spacing-c-50
tokens.usage: 50px: gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: spacing-c-52
tokens.usage: 52px: alternative block gap on service pages.

tokens.name: spacing-c-60
tokens.usage: 60px: section padding on tablet.

tokens.name: spacing-c-100
tokens.usage: 100px: section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: spacing-c-200
tokens.usage: 200px: the largest breathing space, under the hero.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, scrollbar thumb.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Code blocks, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The white button on the CTA banner, dropdown menus.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: CTA banner. Cards and Inputs use Tailwind rounded-xl (12px = radius-lg).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Large feature panels and image frames.

tokens.name: radius-20
tokens.usage: Custom 20px corner for case-study cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Every Button, Pill and StatusBadge (Tailwind rounded-full). Pills are the brand's control shape.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Small lift for chips.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdowns.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers and the open mobile menu.

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Modals.

tokens.name: shadow-red-sm
tokens.usage: Hover glow of the primary Button.

tokens.name: shadow-red-md
tokens.usage: Hover glow of the accent Button.

tokens.name: shadow-red-lg
tokens.usage: Strongest glow, for one hero element per page.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Elevated Card.

tokens.name: shadow-elevated
tokens.usage: Hovered elevated Card and floating panels.

tokens.name: max-width
tokens.usage: Content width of a section.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Outer .container limit.

tokens.name: breakpoint-xs
tokens.usage: Smallest phone layout.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Tablet layout.

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop layout.

tokens.name: breakpoint-xl
tokens.usage: Wide desktop.
